variant.title: Odd/Even Sudoku
variant.description: Marked cells must match their odd or even parity mark.
rule.odd_even_parity: The digit does not match this cell's odd/even mark.
rule_guide.title: Odd/Even Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: Odd-marked cells must contain odd digits, and even-marked cells must contain even digits.
